business_problem: CyberAgent needed a secure, governed way to spread AI across advertising, media, gaming, and development teams so employees could work faster and make better decisions without risking uncontrolled data use or fragmented adoption.
solution_summary: CyberAgent built its enterprise AI environment around ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex so AI could become a default layer in daily work rather than a narrow advanced initiative. ChatGPT Enterprise provides the secure foundation for research, drafting, summarization, and decision support across teams, backed by account management, usage visibility, and internal guidelines for handling confidential information. The company then built culture and operations around adoption: Slack follow-ups for inactive users, prompt and use-case sharing, internal rankings for self-visibility, and more than ten OpenAI-led training sessions covering basics, custom GPTs, hackathons, and Codex. Codex extends the environment into design review, code review, documentation, and upstream planning, helping teams pressure-test proposals before implementation and even build systems such as the company’s internal usage-ranking tool. The result is high voluntary adoption without mandates and better-quality decisions earlier in workflows.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT Enterprise
solution_components.role: Acts as the secure company-wide AI workspace for research, drafting, summarization, and everyday decision support.

solution_components.name: Codex
solution_components.role: Supports design reviews, code reviews, documentation, planning, and adjacent product work across technical and non-technical teams.

data_flow: Employee work such as research, drafts, proposals, code changes, and documentation flows into ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex under internal governance rules. Usage data and Slack follow-ups then feed the adoption loop, while teams share prompts and successful patterns back across the company.
business_outcome: CyberAgent achieved broad monthly adoption, improved quality and speed in design and engineering work, and turned AI from isolated experimentation into a governed operating layer that teams choose because it helps them move faster.
